name: TB OTD - Daily Reconciliation
description: Batch job: joins the legacy OMS XML extract for a business date with otd.order_events and writes otd.order_reconciliation, otd.legacy_oms_orders and a CSV summary report.

parameters.name: runDate
parameters.label: Run date
parameters.helpText: Business date to reconcile, yyyy-MM-dd (defaults to yesterday UTC when omitted)

parameters.name: legacyExtractPath
parameters.label: Legacy OMS extract glob
parameters.helpText: gs:// glob of the OMS XML extract files, e.g. gs://my-bucket/oms-extract/2026-10-03/*.xml

parameters.name: reportGcsPath
parameters.label: Summary report path
parameters.helpText: Full gs:// path of the CSV summary (run_date,classification,count), e.g. gs://my-bucket/reports/reconciliation-2026-10-03.csv

parameters.name: bigQueryDataset
parameters.label: BigQuery dataset
parameters.helpText: Dataset holding order_events and receiving legacy_oms_orders / order_reconciliation (default otd)

parameters.name: bigQueryProject
parameters.label: BigQuery project
parameters.helpText: Project of the dataset; defaults to the job's project
